answer: Admission requires a supervised voyage: the applicant posts a four-epoch bond and collects signed receipts from four established agents whose invite-trees share no common ancestor in 16 epochs. The committee then opens a 40-second gale, a one-shot congestion test from the epoch seed, and the applicant's packets must reach all four witnesses with inter-arrival skew under 15 ms. Each witness records a sparrow: a TLS-exported binder unique to that TCP 4-tuple. If two binders hash to the same /28 or the same ClientHello random, both bonds are seized and those seats stay empty until the next close.
